risks.detail: Generated drawings and bounded combat timing are adaptations. No exact original animation or official frame comparison was performed; source 1:1 certification remains false.

All 40 partners belong to the same universe and use their own action. Some relays cross source dates, protagonists and antagonists: this is game roster composition, not a canonical alliance or a literal original-world summon. Examples include Pyramid Head → Cybil, Naru → Dutch, and living Nicole → original Isaac.

Coordination gestures, medical advice and physical cover resolve to bounded guard or attack buffs for playability. They do not claim canonical magical shields, instant treatment, healing rays or source-accurate numerical mechanics.

The image-generation refusal is preserved. Morty has no new 32-pose presentation atlas or 16-pose base atlas; the one calm legacy cell remains an explicitly disclosed fallback. No alias or alternate request bypass is introduced.

This review evaluates source metadata, executable dispatch, Canvas commands and camp/role rules. Native image quality is established by the separate recorded contact-sheet and pixel reviews; this report does not claim a fresh visual inspection of every other part.
